sentences.englishText: Pam Robinson is a stewardess who is currently in Tokyo and writing to her father.
sentences.turkishText: Pam Robinson şu anda Tokyo'da olan ve babasına mektup yazan bir hostestir.

sentences.englishText: She visited Istanbul yesterday and had enough free time to see the city and eat lunch.
sentences.turkishText: Dün İstanbul'u ziyaret etti ve şehri gezip öğle yemeği yiyecek kadar boş vakti vardı.

sentences.englishText: She likes her job very much but admits that she was extremely tired last month.
sentences.turkishText: İşini çok seviyor ama geçen ay çok yorgun olduğunu itiraf ediyor.

enrichment.summary: Pam Robinson is a stewardess who is currently in Tokyo and writing to her father. She visited Istanbul yesterday and had enough free time to see the city and eat lunch.
